title: French Claypot Coq au Vin
description: A classic French dish made with chicken cooked in a claypot with wine and mushrooms, resulting in a rich, savory sauce.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp of butter in a claypot over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the claypot and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the claypot and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp of butter to the claypot.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Add the wine, thyme, and bay leaves to the claypot.
Return the chicken to the claypot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the claypot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the claypot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the Coq au Vin hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
